scope: synthetic-only directed-outward perturbation theorem for the fixed-set routed MoE aggregate

semantics.selected_set_precondition: exactly eight unique expert IDs with membership invariance independently proven
semantics.expert_output: routed expert down-projection vector e_i in IEEE-754 binary32, promoted exactly to binary64 for aggregation
semantics.routing_weight: ID-keyed IEEE-754 binary64 q_i=2.5*p_i/max(sum_{k in T}(p_k),2^-14)
semantics.scaling: the 2.5 expert scale is already included in q_i; no further routed-aggregate scale
semantics.shared_expert: added after routed_aggregate into combined_moe and excluded from this perturbation theorem
semantics.residual: added after combined_moe and excluded from this perturbation theorem

budget_candidates.name: R10 routing coefficient
budget_candidates.disposition: preserved separately; cannot govern vector aggregate perturbation

budget_candidates.name: R10 intermediate Tier-B
budget_candidates.original_purpose: intermediate complete-layer surfaces including weighted aggregation

budget_candidates.name: R10 final Tier-B
budget_candidates.disposition: not adopted because downstream additions are outside the protected boundary

perturbation_theorem.reference: c_k is the deterministic midpoint of the hull of all eight expert-output intervals at coordinate k
perturbation_theorem.dependency_rule: intersect the direct and centered sound enclosures; never assume endpoint cancellation
perturbation_theorem.joint_sum_rule: sum_i(q_i-q0_i) is supplied by the common-denominator joint weight-sum interval, not by independently summing weight endpoints
perturbation_theorem.cosine_bound: outward lower bound on cosine(M0,M) from componentwise M0+delta_M intervals; fail closed if either norm can be zero
perturbation_theorem.signed_outputs: full signed interval multiplication; no positivity assumption
perturbation_theorem.rounding: every arithmetic lower endpoint rounds toward negative infinity and every upper endpoint toward positive infinity via binary64 nextafter

acceptance.mathematical_pass: all three routed_aggregate intermediate Tier-B bounds pass
acceptance.engineering_pass: mathematical pass and the minimum aggregate safety factor is at least 2

safety_factor.aggregate: minimum of the applicable three factors

required_future_evidence.input: selected expert IDs, nominal q0_i, q_i intervals, and common-denominator joint weight-sum interval
required_future_evidence.status: already committed public in route and weight-qualification evidence

required_future_evidence.input: R10 intermediate max-absolute, RMSE, and cosine budgets plus routed-aggregate semantics
eight exact nominal real routed-expert down-output vectors e0_i[6144], ID-keyed, canonical f32
required_future_evidence.status: not present in committed/public evidence or currently authorized retained dense-prefix/router packages; resolution requires a separate evidence-presence loop

required_future_evidence.input: nominal routed aggregate M0, per-coordinate output hulls, and expert-output norms
required_future_evidence.status: deterministically derivable after the exact nominal expert-output vectors are independently verified

required_future_evidence.input: per-expert componentwise output intervals if joint weight/output qualification is requested
required_future_evidence.status: optional for weight-only evaluation; otherwise unavailable without separately authorized evidence

fail_closed_conditions: not exactly eight unique ID-keyed experts
missing or extra routing-weight or expert-output field
nominal weight or output outside its interval
direct and centered enclosures do not intersect
nominal or admissible aggregate norm may be zero for cosine qualification
attempt to infer real expert outputs from aggregate PASS requirements
attempt to use aggregate qualification as coefficient PASS
attempt to use final-output tolerance at the routed_aggregate boundary
